messages:
taylor_pm: Quick sync — need a rollout plan for 'capacity-aware routing v2' (the change that steers traffic based on pool utilization). Goal is to avoid the oscillation we saw in last regional resize and make sure customers don't hit sudden latency/cost spikes.

aj_eng: Got it. Are we thinking phased % canaries + region gating?

taylor_pm: Yes. Proposal: super-small global smoke (1%), then region slices (10%, 30%), then ramp. Each phase has a safety window and automatic rollback criteria. Also want an A/B cohort for a subset of enterprise tenants.

sam_k: For the enterprise cohort we should pin model variant and disable auto-quantization to avoid perf variance.

maria_data: I'll prepare real-traffic evals (latency, token/sec, cost per 1k tokens) and signal queries to run during each phase. Need the exact metrics list from SRE.

jin_sre: From SRE side: primary signals = regional error-rate, p50/p95/p99 latency, queue-depth, token throughput, and model OOM counts. Kill-switch thresholds: error-rate jump >0.5pp over baseline OR p99 increase >30% sustained for 5m. Also watch for traffic oscillation pattern (back-and-forth >=2 region moves in 10m).

aj_eng: Can do feature-flag orchestration. Suggest flag schema:
```
flag: cap_route_v2
phases:
  - pct: 1     # global smoke
    duration: 30m
  - pct: 10    # regional slices
    regions: [us-east-1, eu-west-1]
    duration: 2h
  - pct: 30
    regions: [us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-northeast-1]
kill_switch:
  error_rate_delta: 0.5%
  p99_latency_increase_pct: 30
  sustained_duration: 5m
fallback: baseline-routing
```

aj_eng: We'll implement auto-fallback to baseline-routing + notify channel.

jin_sre: Add two more things: 1) a cooldown window after each phase (15m) before increasing traffic, and 2) enforce a minimum sample size (e.g., 5000 requests) to avoid noisy metrics.

maria_data: A/B cohort config: 50 tenants, stratified by qps and model mix. I'll supply tenant IDs. We'll collect quality metrics too (BLEU-like similarity for structured outputs).

sam_k: Docs/console: show flag state per-region, phase, and reason for any auto-fallback. Also add a small banner for affected customers if cohort includes enterprise tenants.

aj_eng: Estimated work: 2d to wire flag + orchestration, 1d to add metrics hooks, 1d to add console UI bits.

jin_sre: I'll produce the runbook for oncall with playbook steps and the pager thresholds. ops_oncall, can you review before we lock thresholds?

ops_oncall: Yep, will review. Also ask: do we allow manual abort from console during phased rollout?

taylor_pm: Yes — manual abort allowed. But require two approvers for aborts that affect >10% traffic.

deploy-bot: canary deployment started: cap_route_v2 -> us-east-1 (1%)

aj_eng: rolling out smoke now. monitor dashboard link: https://redwood.internal/observability/dashboards/cap-route-v2

maria_data: I'll run synthetic traffic for the first 30m to exercise edge cases.

jin_sre: alert hooks added to channel #eng-oncall and to ops pager. If rollback triggers, deploy-bot will revert and post reason.

ops_oncall: acknowledged. I'll be on watch for the next 90m.

taylor_pm: Action items: @aj_eng implement flag + fallback, @maria_data prepare evals + tenant list, @jin_sre runbook + alerts, @sam_k console UI banner. We'll reconvene after the 2h regional slice to decide next ramp.

aj_eng: copying tasks to PR and will post the PR link here when ready.

deploy-bot: canary deployment completed: cap_route_v2 -> us-east-1 (1%) — OK

sam_k: quick note: add metric for cost-per-token delta in the dashboard so PMs can judge unit economics during ramp.

maria_data: adding cost delta.

taylor_pm: thanks everyone. If thresholds hold after regional slices, we'll plan enterprise A/B next week.

ops_oncall: thumbs up :thumbsup:
